The '''black and white bird''' figurine is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Store Room]] in [[Ebou Dar]].

==Appearance==
The bird is colored black and white. It has long wings that appear stretched out as if it is in flight.

==Use==
This ''ter'angreal'' can supposedly be used to speak to people over great distances, much like the [[blue woman]], five earrings, six finger rings, and three bracelets.{{ref/book|11|15}}

==Parallels==
The black and white bird is the parallel of several long-distance communication devices, but most foremostly of the telephone.
